findings.finding: A zero-mean first-order autoregressive model with coefficient between zero and one gives a decaying mean prediction. Applying exponential forgetting only to the stale vertical disturbance is a testable engineering hypothesis, not a calibrated gust model or EKF.
findings.relevance: The retained ideal seed-1 trace holds a positive vertical acceleration residual while the landing gust changes, producing velocity error before touchdown
findings.direction_alignment: Test one bounded correction and make its controller, actuator and contact behavior directly inspectable
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Forgetting can reduce a stale bias or erase a useful persistent force estimate; original failures and new seed outcomes must remain visible
findings.engineering_cost: Opt-in predictor, versioned evidence reconstruction, eighteen final PhysX flights and ten related demonstration features
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-024 evaluates vertical disturbance decay with regression and predeclared additional seeds
findings.verification_needed: Exact normal-capture continuity, clean-source runtime identity, full-rate original gates, independently checked diagnostic arithmetic, actual live and recorded 3D

overall_recommendation: Measure the predeclared candidate without changing gains, default behavior or acceptance limits.
evidence_gaps: No estimator uncertainty propagation or real sensor fusion
Three additional seeds are a bounded check, not statistical validation
Ideal attitude/contact supervision and AL-010 yaw refinement remain limitations
